title: AI Marketing Automation: Acquire, Nurture, Retain, Report

sections.label: 1 · CAPTURE EVERY LEAD AND CUSTOMER EVENT
sections.note: Form fills, purchases and signups all land in one place and get cleaned into the same shape.

sections.label: 2 · DECIDE WHO THEY ARE AND WHAT THEY GET NEXT
sections.note: Claude looks the person up in the CRM and picks the next best message instead of a fixed drip.

sections.label: 3 · ACQUISITION: WELCOME THE NEW ONES
sections.note: Brand new contacts get the welcome and the first offer straight away, while interest is highest.

sections.label: 4 · NURTURE AND RETENTION: KEEP THEM MOVING
sections.note: Nurture loops a personalized touch every two days until they engage, capped so nobody gets spammed. Quiet customers get a win back instead.

sections.label: 5 · MEASURE, REPORT, AND CATCH FAILURES
sections.note: Every send updates the CRM and logs a metrics row, and Monday morning the numbers land in Slack.
